story: Sophie and her friend Chloe are at the pet shop. The pet shop has three rabbits. The rabbits are sitting in a big, soft basket. Sophie wants to hold a brown rabbit. [emotion:QT/surprised] The brown rabbit is too fast! The rabbit hops out of the basket. [emotion:QT/afraid] The rabbit hides under a chair. Chloe gets down and reaches under the chair. Chloe catches the rabbit gently. Sophie holds the rabbit. The rabbit has thick, white spots on the chest. [emotion:QT/happy] Sophie and Chloe are so happy.
